founderDecisionRecommendations.Josh 3:10 'the living El': Ship. It is the only rendering consistent with the Torah's bare-ʾēl 'El' and it keeps ʾēl ḥay distinct from 'the living Elohim' (1 Sam 17:26). Caveat for the harmonisation list: Isaiah/Latter Prophets render ʾēl 'God', so the Hebrew Bible now has two practices for bare ʾēl.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ בַּבֹּ֜קֶר וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵֽהַשִּׁטִּ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֖וּא וְכָל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּלִ֥נוּ שָׁ֖ם טֶ֥רֶם יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua rose early in the morning, and they set out from Shittim and came to the Yarden, he and all the children of Yisra'el; and they lodged there before they crossed over.

notes.official: 'Yehoshua' = Joshua; 'Yarden' = Jordan; 'Yisra'el' = Israel (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *mēhaššiṭṭîm* 'from Shittim' (ASV): the name has the article ('the acacias'), and the Torah volumes print the full form 'Avel-haShittim' (Num 33:49). The Former Prophets keep the ASV short form here. Josh 2:1 and 3:1 frame the spies' story with the same camp.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֕י מִקְצֵ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ הַשֹּׁטְרִ֖ים בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days that the officers went through the midst of the camp;

notes.official: *miqṣēh šəlōšeṯ yāmîm* 'at the end of three days' picks up the three days of 1:11 and 2:22. *haššōṭərîm* 'the officers', the administrative officials of 1:10.

paragraphs.text: וַיְצַוּוּ֮ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ כִּרְאֽוֹתְכֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאִ֖ים אֹת֑וֹ וְאַתֶּ֗ם תִּסְעוּ֙ מִמְּק֣וֹמְכֶ֔ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אַחֲרָֽיו׃

i18n.en: and they commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of YHWH your Elohim, and the priests the Levites carrying it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.

notes.official: *ʾărôn bərîṯ-YHWH ʾĕlōhêḵem* 'the ark of the covenant of YHWH your Elohim' (central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`; `elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`, clause 3). *wəhakkōhănîm halwiyyim* 'and the priests the Levites': the Deuteronomic title of the priests (Deut 17:9; 18:1), kept in its apposition (ASV). Josh 3-4 alternates between 'the ark of the covenant', 'the ark of YHWH' and 'the ark', and the line renders each genitive as the Hebrew gives it.

paragraphs.text: אַ֣ךְ ׀ רָח֣וֹק יִהְיֶ֗ה בֵּֽינֵיכֶם֙ ובינו [וּבֵינָ֔יו] כְּאַלְפַּ֥יִם אַמָּ֖ה בַּמִּדָּ֑ה אַֽל־תִּקְרְב֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו לְמַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־תֵּֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֧א עֲבַרְתֶּ֛ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃ (ס)

i18n.en: Only there shall be a distance between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure; do not come near it, that you may know the way by which you must go, for you have not passed this way before."

notes.official: *ʾaḵ rāḥôq yihyeh bênêḵem ûḇênāyw* 'Only there shall be a distance between you and it': the Ketiv *wbynw* and the Qere *ûḇênāyw* 'and between it' differ only in spelling; the line translates the Qere (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). *kəʾalpayim ʾammâ* 'about two thousand cubits', roughly a kilometre, the same measure as the Levitical pasture-land of Num 35:5. *kî lōʾ ʿăḇartem badderek mittəmôl šilšôm* 'for you have not passed this way before', literally 'yesterday and the day before'.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־הָעָ֖ם הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua said to the people, "Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow YHWH will do wonders among you."

notes.official: *hiṯqaddāšû* 'Sanctify yourselves', as before the Sinai theophany (Ex 19:10-15) and before the meat of Num 11:18. *niplāʾôṯ* 'wonders', the word for the deeds of the Exodus (Ex 3:20; 34:10).

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וְעִבְר֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And Yehoshua spoke to the priests, saying, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass over before the people." And they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.

notes.official: *śəʾû ʾeṯ-ʾărôn habbərîṯ wəʿiḇrû lip̄nê hāʿām* 'Take up the ark of the covenant and pass over before the people' (central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`). The verse reports the carrying out of the order at once; the crossing itself is narrated from v 14.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְךָ֔ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Yehoshua, "This day I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Yisra'el, that they may know that as I was with Moshe, so I will be with you.

notes.official: *hayyôm hazzeh ʾāḥēl gaddelḵā* 'This day I will begin to make you great'. *kaʾăšer hāyîṯî ʿim-mōšeh ʾehyeh ʿimmāḵ* 'as I was with Moshe, so I will be with you': the presence formula of 1:5 (central `elohim-imkha-divine-presence-formula`). 'Moshe' = Moses, in the Former Prophets form (the Torah volumes print 'Moses').

paragraphs.text: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרֽוֹן־הַבְּרִ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּבֹאֲכֶ֗ם עַד־קְצֵה֙ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בַּיַּרְדֵּ֖ן תַּעֲמֹֽדוּ׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And you shall command the priests who carry the ark of the covenant, saying, 'When you come to the edge of the waters of the Yarden, you shall stand still in the Yarden.'"

notes.official: *ʿaḏ-qəṣēh mê hayyardēn* 'to the edge of the waters of the Yarden'. *bayyardēn taʿămōḏû* 'you shall stand still in the Yarden'. YHWH's instruction to Yehoshua quotes the command he is to give, in single marks.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua said to the children of Yisra'el, "Come here, and hear the words of YHWH your Elohim."

notes.official: *gōšû hēnnâ* 'Come here'. *ʾeṯ-diḇrê YHWH ʾĕlōhêḵem* 'the words of YHWH your Elohim' (`elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`, clause 3).

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֛י אֵ֥ל חַ֖י בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵ֣שׁ יוֹרִ֣ישׁ מִ֠פְּנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י וְאֶת־הַחִתִּ֜י וְאֶת־הַחִוִּ֗י וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְאֶת־הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua said, "By this you shall know that the living El is among you, and that he will surely drive out from before you the Kena'anites, and the Chittites, and the Chivvites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Emorites, and the Yevusites.

notes.official:
*bəzōʾṯ tēḏəʿûn kî ʾēl ḥay bəqirbəḵem* 'By this you shall know that the living El is among you'. The Hebrew has the singular *ʾēl* with a singular adjective, not the plural-agreement *ʾĕlōhîm ḥayyîm* of 1 Sam 17:26, 36 ('the living Elohim'). The phrase recurs in Hos 2:1 (ET 1:10) and Ps 42:3; 84:3. The corpus transliterates bare *ʾēl* as 'El', as the Torah overlays and the central El-compounds do (el-elyon, el-shaddai), and English needs a determiner with the adjective (`elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`, clause 8; ASV 'the living God').

*hôrēš yôrîš* 'he will surely drive out': the infinitive absolute strengthens the verb. The seven peoples are rendered under the Former Prophets '-ite' rule (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`): 'the Kena'anites, the Chittites, the Chivvites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Emorites, the Yevusites' = the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Jebusite (ASV, collective singulars). The plural follows the published Josh 5:1. genesis-woh writes the same list with '-i' forms (central ten-nations-of-canaan), and the gentilic question is a pending corpus decision.

paragraphs.text: הִנֵּה֙ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲד֖וֹן כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ עֹבֵ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם בַּיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

i18n.en: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is passing over before you into the Yarden.

notes.official: *hinnēh ʾărôn habbərîṯ ʾăḏôn kol-hāʾāreṣ ʿōḇēr lip̄nêḵem bayyardēn* 'Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is passing over before you into the Yarden'. The construct chain is unusual: *habbərîṯ* has the article, which normally ends a chain, so *ʾăḏôn kol-hāʾāreṣ* may be an apposition to the ark ('the ark of the covenant, the Lord of all the earth'), as if the ark itself were called by the title. The accents allow both readings. The line follows the ASV construct reading, which v 13 *ʾărôn YHWH ʾăḏôn kol-hāʾāreṣ* supports, and records the alternative (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`; Nelson, *Joshua*, OTL, 1997). *ʾăḏôn kol-hāʾāreṣ* 'the Lord of all the earth' is a universal title (Mic 4:13; Zech 4:14; Ps 97:5), so *hāʾāreṣ* is 'the earth' here (central `eretz`, universal-formula clause proposed in this wave). *ʾăḏôn* is the ordinary noun 'lord', not the divine *ʾăḏōnāy*.

paragraphs.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר אִ֔ישׁ מִשִּׁבְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃

i18n.en: And now take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Yisra'el, one man for each tribe.

notes.official: *šənê ʿāśār ʾîš* 'twelve men', one for each tribe: they are chosen here and given their task, the twelve memorial stones, only in 4:2-8.

paragraphs.text: וְהָיָ֡ה כְּנ֣וֹחַ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאֵי֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה אֲד֤וֹן כָּל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יִכָּ֣רֵת֔וּן הַמַּ֥יִם הַיֹּרְדִ֖ים מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְיַעַמְד֖וּ נֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃

i18n.en: And it shall come to pass, when the soles of the feet of the priests who carry the ark of YHWH, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Yarden, that the waters of the Yarden shall be cut off, the waters that come down from above, and they shall stand in one heap."

notes.official: *kənôaḥ kappôṯ raḡlê hakkōhănîm* 'when the soles of the feet of the priests ... rest'. *mê hayyardēn yikkārēṯûn* 'the waters of the Yarden shall be cut off'. *wəyaʿamḏû nēḏ ʾeḥāḏ* 'and they shall stand in one heap' (overlay `ned-echad-waters-stand-in-one-heap-joshua-3`): *nēḏ* is the word of the Song of the Sea, 'the floods stood upright as a heap' (Ex 15:8; Ps 78:13), so the Jordan crossing is told in the language of the Sea crossing. *ʾăḏôn kol-hāʾāreṣ* as in v 11 (central `eretz`).

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּנְסֹ֤עַ הָעָם֙ מֵאָ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים נֹֽשְׂאֵ֛י הָאָר֥וֹן הַבְּרִ֖ית לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass, when the people set out from their tents to cross over the Yarden, with the priests who carried the ark of the covenant before the people,

notes.official: *hāʾārôn habbərîṯ* 'the ark of the covenant': the article stands on both nouns of the construct, an anomaly that recurs at v 17 (*hāʾārôn bərîṯ-YHWH*). It is translated as an ordinary construct (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`). It is often explained as a conflation of the two expressions 'the ark' and 'the ark of the covenant'. Vv 14-16 form one long sentence: v 14 is the time clause, v 15 continues it, and the main clause begins in v 16.

paragraphs.text: וּכְב֞וֹא נֹשְׂאֵ֤י הָֽאָרוֹן֙ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְרַגְלֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָֽאָר֔וֹן נִטְבְּל֖וּ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַמָּ֑יִם וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מָלֵא֙ עַל־כָּל־גְּדוֹתָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י קָצִֽיר׃

i18n.en: and when those who carried the ark came to the Yarden, and the feet of the priests who carried the ark were dipped in the edge of the water (for the Yarden overflows all its banks all the days of harvest),

notes.official:
*nōśəʾê hāʾārôn* 'those who carried the ark' (central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`). *niṭbəlû biqṣēh hammāyim* 'were dipped in the edge of the water'. *wəhayyardēn mālēʾ ʿal-kol-gəḏôṯāyw kōl yəmê qāṣîr* 'for the Yarden overflows all its banks all the days of harvest': the parenthesis stresses the difficulty. The spring harvest is the season of the river's flood, from the snowmelt of the Hermon (cf. 4:19, the tenth of the first month).

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** *The Book Which Tells the Truth* (ch. 3) quotes vv 15-16 ('(…) as soon as the bearers of the ark were come (…) the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap a great way off (…) the waters were wholly cut off, and the people passed over (…)'). It reads the crossing as the work of the creators, who made the people pass over dry-shod 'using the same repelling ray' as at the sea. The line renders the verbs and nouns of the crossing literally and does not encode that reading.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּעַמְד֡וּ הַמַּיִם֩ הַיֹּרְדִ֨ים מִלְמַ֜עְלָה קָ֣מוּ נֵד־אֶחָ֗ד הַרְחֵ֨ק מְאֹ֜ד באדם [מֵֽאָדָ֤ם] הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצַּ֣ד צָֽרְתָ֔ן וְהַיֹּרְדִ֗ים עַ֣ל יָ֧ם הָעֲרָבָ֛ה יָם־הַמֶּ֖לַח תַּ֣מּוּ נִכְרָ֑תוּ וְהָעָ֥ם עָבְר֖וּ נֶ֥גֶד יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: that the waters which came down from above stood still; they rose up in one heap, very far off, from Adam, the city that is beside Tzaretan; and those that went down toward the Sea of the Aravah, the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off; and the people crossed over opposite Yericho.

notes.official: *wayyaʿamḏû hammayim hayyōrəḏîm milmaʿlâ qāmû nēḏ-ʾeḥāḏ* 'that the waters which came down from above stood still; they rose up in one heap' (overlay `ned-echad-waters-stand-in-one-heap-joshua-3`). *harḥēq məʾōḏ mēʾāḏām hāʿîr ʾăšer miṣṣaḏ ṣārṯān* 'very far off, from Adam, the city that is beside Tzaretan': the Ketiv *bʾdm* 'at Adam' (followed by the ASV, 'a great way off, at Adam') and the Qere *mēʾāḏām* 'from Adam'. The line translates the Qere, which places the blockage at Adam, upstream (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). Adam is usually identified with Tell ed-Damiyeh, about 30 km upstream of the crossing, near the mouth of the Jabbok. Blockages of the river by collapsing banks there are recorded in 1267 and 1927 CE (Garstang, *Joshua-Judges*, 1931), and commentators cite them without deciding the question (Boling and Wright, AB 6, 1982). 'Tzaretan' = Zarethan; *yām hāʿărāḇâ yām-hammelaḥ* 'the Sea of the Aravah, the Salt Sea' = the Dead Sea (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *tammû niḵrāṯû* 'were wholly cut off'. *neḡeḏ yərîḥô* 'opposite Yericho' (Jericho). The canon quotes this verse; see the reception note at v 15.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּעַמְד֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹ֠שְׂאֵי הָאָר֨וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֜ה בֶּחָֽרָבָ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הָכֵ֑ן וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹֽבְרִים֙ בֶּחָ֣רָבָ֔ה עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֙מּוּ֙ כָּל־הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

i18n.en: And the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of YHWH stood firm on dry ground in the midst of the Yarden, and all Yisra'el was crossing over on dry ground, until all the nation had finished crossing over the Yarden.

notes.official: *hāʾārôn bərîṯ-YHWH* 'the ark of the covenant of YHWH': the article on the construct, as at v 14. *beḥārāḇâ ... hāḵēn* 'firm on dry ground': *ḥārāḇâ* 'dry ground' is the word of Ex 14:21 (overlay `ned-echad-waters-stand-in-one-heap-joshua-3`). *hāḵēn* 'firmly' (ASV 'firm'). *ʿaḏ ʾăšer-tammû kol-haggôy* 'until all the nation had finished crossing over'.
